label: ARM SKU
hint: Must be Standard_…; do not infer it from the meter name.

label: Instance count
hint: Enter 1 for a single-VM record; billing Quantity is not instance count.

label: Cloud environment
hint: Commercial / China / Government / Sovereign / Unknown

label: Operating system
hint: Linux / Windows; other names do not automatically match prices.

label: Total instance-hours
hint: Total hours across all instances; do not multiply by instance count again.

label: Running hours per instance
hint: Mutually exclusive with total instance-hours.

label: Usage unit
hint: 1 Hour; other units, such as per-core hours, are not accepted.

label: Source period start
hint: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive of this date.

label: Source period end
hint: YYYY-MM-DD, exclusive of this date.

label: CPU P95 %
hint: Enter 0–100; this is not average CPU.

label: Memory P99 %
hint: Enter 0–100; no definitive downsizing recommendation is made without memory data.

label: Network P95 Mbps
hint: Outbound network bandwidth, not a percentage or MB/s.

label: Business peaks covered
hint: yes / no / Leave blank if unknown

label: Workload type
hint: user-facing / batch / unknown

label: Required temporary disk GiB
hint: Enter 0 only if no temporary-disk dependency is confirmed; leave blank if unknown.

label: CPU architecture
hint: x64; Arm and other architectures require specialized assessment.

label: Specialized requirements
hint: none / manual; enter manual for certification, managed compute, or special licensing.

label: Agreement type
hint: EA / MCA / Unknown

label: Purchase option
hint: PAYG / RI / SavingsPlan / Mixed / Unknown

label: Remaining commitment cost after migration
hint: Must match this fixed-usage comparison period; not an annual commitment charge.

label: Source PAYG/effective hourly rate
hint: In RI baseline mode, enter the PAYG base rate in this column.

label: Source compute cost
hint: VM compute only; exclude disks, taxes, licensing, and other charges.

label: Cost basis
hint: Actual / Amortized

label: Rate basis
hint: baseline is the pre-scenario baseline; effective is the rate already in effect.

label: Rate end date
hint: Exclusive of this date.

label: Price source type
hint: customer / retail / demo

label: Customer's effective associated storage cost
hint: Customer-substantiated value for the same usage on the assessment date.
